skill_name: After watching the movie Titanic, compose a reflective essay about the film.
workflow: The movie Titanic is a powerful and moving story of tragedy and romance. It tells the tale of a forbidden love between Jack and Rose, two individuals from different social classes who meet on board the ill-fated ship. As the story unfolds, we witness their relationship grow, both in its intensity and in its tragedy.
